chunks: In seven places: in the first two rak'ahs of Salat al-Layl, in the two rak'ahs before Fajr, in the two rak'ahs of zawal, in the two rak'ahs after Maghrib, in the two rak'ahs of Tawaf, in the two rak'ahs of Ihram, and in Fajr when you begin the day with it.

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الطَّوَافِ: the two rak'ahs performed after Tawaf
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْإِحْرَامِ: the two rak'ahs associated with entering Ihram

ai.seo_question: In which prayers is it recommended to recite Surah al-Ikhlas and Surah al-Kafirun?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs one not to neglect reciting Surah al-Ikhlas and Surah al-Kafirun in specific recommended prayers and devotional settings. It highlights the special virtue of these two surahs in acts of worship connected to the night prayer, dawn, Maghrib, Tawaf, and Ihram.
